npm.desc: Start the website on PORT (default 8080), and the model service with it. The pages are built first if they are missing.
Runs by itself before npm start: builds pages/ when it is empty.
Start the website and restart it when app.js or server/ change.
Start only the Python model service, in the foreground, on MODEL_HOST:MODEL_PORT. For working on models or running them on a GPU machine.
Install the model service's Python packages (pip install -r model/requirements.txt).
Rebuild pages/ from pages_original/ and the JSON patches. Run it after a new Claude Design export or a patch change.
Rebuild in memory and report whether the patches still apply and pages/ is current. Writes nothing.
Check every link in the built pages against site/site.json.
Regenerate this page. Run it after adding, removing or changing a file, route or variable, then commit docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.html.

Everything that needs neither a browser nor credentials, in order, with one summary. Add -- --e2e for the browser tests, -- --strict to fail instead of skip when Python is missing, -- --only js to run one step.
The browser tests: Chrome drives the real pages against a fake Google.

extra.desc: Create your settings file, then paste your Google credentials into it.
Try the whole Design Studio without credentials: the real site and model service against a fake Google, using the built-in synthetic room.
Is it up? Shows the version, the Google mode and the model service status.
The link check as JSON: which page links to which.
Fail with a list if this overview and the project disagree, or the committed page is stale. Writes nothing.
